market_outlook.short_term: CPI data is the dominant catalyst. Expect volatility as inflation tick-up confirms Fed hike path. Oil at $108 and diesel at $6 create immediate consumer pressure. Stocks at highs face bond-yield headwind. Bessent's failed rate intervention signals policy uncertainty. 1-3 months: choppy, risk-off bias on rate-sensitive names, energy outperformance.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 months: AI security and semiconductor consolidation are structural winners. BRICS multipolarity and India's rise create EM rotation opportunity. Oil demand 'lost period' per IEA caps energy upside beyond 12 months. Consumer squeeze may force Fed to pause hikes, creating a late-2026 relief rally. Geopolitical fragmentation (Iran, trade wars) sustains elevated risk premium.
